description:
A community service organization's presentation contains four chart images across four slides, but none have alternative text descriptions, violating accessibility requirements (Section 508 / WCAG 2.1).

Your task: Add descriptive alt text to the image on each slide by right-clicking the image, selecting 'Description...' (or 'Alt Text...') from the context menu, and entering text in the Description field.

The presentation is already open in LibreOffice Impress: community_impact_report.pptx

For each slide, right-click the chart image, choose 'Description...', and enter the following Description text:

- Slide 1 (Volunteer Hours 2019–2023): "Bar chart showing annual volunteer hours from 2019 to 2023, rising from 58000 to 78000 hours"

- Slide 2 (Funding Sources Breakdown): "Pie chart showing funding sources: Government Grants 42%, Individual Donations 28%, Corporate Sponsors 18%, Fundraising Events 12%"

- Slide 3 (Beneficiaries Served Over Time): "Line chart showing beneficiaries served growing from 1200 in 2019 to 3100 in 2023"

- Slide 4 (Program Satisfaction Ratings): "Horizontal bar chart of program satisfaction ratings: Youth Mentoring 4.7, Food Assistance 4.5, Job Training 4.3, Housing Support 4.1, Health Outreach 3.9 out of 5"

After adding alt text to all four images, save the presentation as:
/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/community_impact_accessible.odp

Use File -> Save As, and select ODF Presentation (.odp) as the format.
